description: Validate one ISO 20022 bank statement (camt.053.001.02, camt.053.001.08, camt.054.001.02, or camt.054.001.08) against the official XML Schema via POST https://checksepa.com/v1/camt/validate. No API key. This route shares the free limit with pain.001 validate and camt convert: 30 requests per IP per hour, 200 per UTC day, 2 MB. The file is not stored. Provide exactly one of file_path or xml. Returns valid, format, version, errors, and warnings. Each finding has code, message, path, and line.

file_path.description: Path to a camt XML file. Resolved by this process.

xml.description: camt XML as a string. Use this or file_path.

name: camt_validate
title: Validate camt.053 or camt.054
